title: Series: Labelled Columns
learning_objectives: Create a Series from a dict and read values by label
Explain index alignment in arithmetic between Series
Filter with boolean masks and summarise with mean, nlargest and value_counts
Compare each Series operation with the equivalent dict code
entry_point: make_series(data); add_aligned(a, b); above_mean(s); top_labels(s, k); count_values(items)
hints: `counts = pd.Series(items).value_counts()`; build `{k: int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}`.

failure_feedback.advice: Use `a.add(b, fill_value=0)` so labels in only one Series are not NaN, then `sort_index()`.
Select with `s[s > s.mean()]` and return its index as a list.
Convert the counts to plain ints in a dict.
